title: Against Socinus and Photinians on eternal generation
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): among pontificals Bellarmine book 1 on Christ chapter 18. among juniors Ursinus, Calvin, Zanchi, Junius, Polanus, Tarnovius, Gerhard; Compare Sozomen, Epiphanius, Augustine on heresies; Ostorodius, plus before them Servetus, Valentinus Gentilis, Alciati, Blandrata, Franciscus Davidis, plus ye patriarchs belonging toward all these, Photinus bishop belonging toward Sirmium condemned in ye year 351 by means belonging toward ye Sirmian council, plus Paul belonging toward Samosata — to these with his Socinus also contradict Smalcius. with his Socinus, in vain snarls, denying ye eternal generation belonging toward ye Son belonging toward God out from ye Fathers essence — (1) because ye son would be son belonging toward himself, (2) because there would be infinite sons, (3) because ye Son belonging toward God out from eternity both would have been plus would not have been, (4) because ye Son belonging toward God would still be being generated plus would have to be generated into all eternity — that same which absurdities arise out from a sinister confusion belonging toward finite plus infinite nature — against these things Johannes Crellius ye Frenchman.
pass_b_english: Against these things Johannes Crellius the Frenchman, with his Socinus, in vain snarls, denying the eternal generation of the Son of God from the Fathers essence — (1) because the son would be son of himself, (2) because there would be infinite sons, (3) because the Son of God from eternity both would have been and would not have been, (4) because the Son of God would still be being generated and would have to be generated into all eternity — which absurdities arise from a sinister confusion of finite and infinite nature.

To these with his Socinus also contradict Smalcius, Ostorodius, and before them Servetus, Valentinus Gentilis, Alciati, Blandrata, Franciscus Davidis, and the patriarchs of all these, Photinus bishop of Sirmium condemned in the year 351 by the Sirmian council, and Paul of Samosata. Compare Sozomen, Epiphanius, Augustine on heresies; among juniors Ursinus, Calvin, Zanchi, Junius, Polanus, Tarnovius, Gerhard; among pontificals Bellarmine book 1 on Christ chapter 18.
source_text: Quibus frustra oggannit cum Socino suo Johannes Crellius Francus, negans aeternam Filii Dei ex essentia Patris generationem, 1. quia filius foret sui ipsius filius, 2. quia infiniti forent filii, 3. quia Filius Dei ab aeterno et fuisset et non fuisset, 4. quia Filius Dei adhuc generaretur et in omnem aeternitatem generandus esset — quae absurda ex sinistra confusione finitae et infinitae naturae oriuntur. His vero cum Socino suo contradicunt etiam Smalcius, Ostorodius, et ante illos Servetus, Valentinus Gentilis, Alciatus, Blandrata, Franciscus Davidis, horumque omnium patriarchae Photinus episcopus Syrmiensis anno 351 a concilio Syrmiensi damnatus et Paulus Samosatenus. Confer Sozomenum, Epiphanium, Augustinum de haeresibus; e junioribus Urzinum, Calvinum, Zanchium, Junium, Polanum, Tarnovium, Gerhardum; e pontificiis Bellarminum lib. I de Christo cap. 18.
